dataList.content: Prioritize taking out the Grand Magasin Sisyphe Blueprints before Jeanne can finish them off with her "Focusing" Skill.
When Jeanne's "Engagement" effect is active, use an E.G.O Skill with high Base Power to Clash against her.
Keep a close eye on Meursault's HP.
Pay attention to Jeanne's intended pattern when assigning Skill targets.
Be careful: Sinners hit by Jeanne's Skills cannot roll Heads.
Taking out the Blueprints reduces Jeanne's HP. Use E.G.O Skills with high Attack Weight to defeat them quickly.
Each time you win a Clash against "La Jouissance", The Crimson God [Adulthood] gains "Pwie's Memories" and becomes weaker.

Sinners who have "Shared with Pwie" take less damage from The Crimson God [Adulthood], and The Crimson God [Adulthood] loses SP each time they use a Skill against the said Sinners.

Sinners whose effect changes to "Decision" deal more damage, but also take more damage—exercise caution.
As L'Abject stacks, Speed decreases and damage taken from Bleed increases. Sinners with 5 or more Stacks become targets for The Crimson God [Adulthood]'s powerful additional attack. Exercise caution.
[Phase 1] If a Sinner with 1 Speed Clashes with the Warden's Skill, its Power and Damage increase greatly. Even winning the Clash will still hurt.
[Phase 1] If a Candle of Retribution survives, it inflicts Bind on all Sinners next turn at Turn End. Prioritize defeating it.
[Later Phases] Certain Skills of the enemy can be greatly weakened by Clashing with Sinners who have "Thumping Pulse" or "Stillness".

[Later Phases] The enemy inflicts various types of Nails on Sinners. The enemy's attacks grow stronger based on the target's Nail Stacks, so keep an eye on your Nail Stacks when responding to the enemy's Skills.
